game.intro: October opens with a new moon in Libra and the scales reset to zero. Give us the sound of everything settling.
game.prompt: An old set of balance scales tipping back and forth until it finally settles.

game.intro: Scorpio moon, and something under the porch has opinions. The tabloid crew is on the scene with a flashlight.
game.headline: PORCH INSPECTION REVEALS ___ HAS BEEN LIVING UNDERNEATH ALL SUMMER, REFUSES TO COMMENT

game.intro: Third-sweater Sunday. Saturn wants a number that belongs to you two alone. Count carefully, do not go over.
game.question: Counting forward from Joel's birthday (March 21) to Nancy's (December 22), how many days apart are they?
game.source: Calendar arithmetic: Mar 21 to Mar 31 = 10, Apr-Nov = 244, plus 22 in December = 276 (no February in range, so leap years do not matter).

game.intro: Don't even scream: two identical squirrels, one fence, zero explanation. Three quick choices, no burying answers.
Sagittarius moon, and the arrow just landed in the mailbox. Pick your dream delivery and guess the other's.
game.question: Which would you most love to find in your mailbox this week?

game.intro: The moon climbs home into Capricorn, one patient step at a time. Show us something you climb, too. Zoom in.
game.prompt: Something you climb, step on or reach up for every single day.

game.intro: Halfway lantern night, Capricorn moon. Saturn is lighting the way home with nonsense. Bring your wrongest.
game.question: What do you put inside a lantern to make it glow?

game.intro: The mountain lends a ladder today. Saturn is holding it steady and wants to hear every proud little rung.
game.prompt: A ladder being climbed by someone extremely proud of each rung.

game.intro: Aquarius moon, and the weathervane has opinions it is dying to share. Translate today's sky into emoji only.
game.prompt: Today's weather where you are, plus exactly how you feel about it.

game.intro: Thanksgiving weekend: the long table just added a leaf. Pass the stories around, two true and one tall.
game.prompt: Three things you are thankful for this week. One should be wildly invented.

game.intro: Thanksgiving Monday and the gratitude tide is in. Three holiday picks, ten seconds each, no seconds on stalling.
The leftovers have formed a philosophy club and need a leader. Vote, then guess who the other one backed.
game.question: The leftovers are electing a club president. Who gets your vote?

game.intro: Don't even scream: matching mugs on two different shelves. Zoom in close so the other can't tell whose is whose.
game.prompt: Your favourite mug, from an angle it has never once been seen from.

game.intro: Full moon in Aries! The Tiger's moon rises and Joel's sign gets the spotlight. Saturn wants it wrong and short.
game.question: What colour is the full moon?

game.intro: One hundred percent glow tonight. Ruby and onyx are on the windowsill. Somebody give the moon its howl.
game.prompt: A wolf, a coyote or a very ambitious dog howling at the full moon.

game.intro: Taurus moon, blanket delivery day. The bull is bringing homecoming warmth and the newsroom has questions.
game.headline: BULL SEEN DELIVERING ___ DOOR TO DOOR, TOWN DECLARES EMERGENCY NAP

game.intro: Slow walk through the gold leaves. Saturn has a local history question and a very long memory. Stay under.
game.question: In what year did Nova Scotia become one of Canada's four founding provinces?
game.source: Confederation: Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Ontario and Quebec united under the British North America Act on July 1, 1867.

game.intro: Gemini moon, the twins are swapping accessories again. Three cold-weather picks, ten seconds, choose fast.
A notebook with no spine has applied for a job. Give it a purpose, then guess which one the other picked.
game.question: A notebook with no spine needs a job. What should it hold?

game.intro: Don't even scream: same stranger, two places, one afternoon. Find your own repeat sighting and zoom right in.
game.prompt: Something you spotted twice today in two completely different places.

game.intro: Cancer moon, and the crab is building a hearth. Saturn is warming his hands by your terrible answers.
game.question: What do crabs carry on their backs?

game.intro: Last quarter moon, the lighthouse is on its nap break. Somebody has to cover the night shift very quietly.
game.prompt: A foghorn trying to whisper so it does not wake the lighthouse.

game.intro: Leo moon and the lion is practising its roar for Halloween. Show us your costume, told only in emoji.
game.prompt: A Halloween costume you would actually wear this year.

game.intro: The crescent is wearing a tiny crown tonight. Tell three royal tales of small victories, one of them fake.
game.prompt: Three times you were crowned champion of something extremely tiny.

game.intro: Virgo moon, junk drawer audit. Saturn is holding a clipboard over the drawer. Three choices, ten seconds each.
Halloween week, and a polite ghost has moved in. Choose its forever chore, then guess what the other picked.
game.question: A friendly ghost moves in and offers to do one chore forever. Which one?

game.intro: Libra moon, the last leaf is negotiating terms. Saturn wants close-up evidence of whatever is still hanging on.
game.prompt: The most stubborn leaf, bud or petal still hanging on near you.

game.intro: New moon, and the moon has gone under cover. Saturn asks a science question and wants it beautifully botched.
game.question: Why can't we see the moon during a new moon?

game.intro: Don't even scream: two pumpkins carved the exact same grin on two different porches. Give us your best gourd giggle.
game.prompt: A jack-o'-lantern laughing at its own joke.

game.intro: Costume rehearsal of doom! The new moon is in Scorpio and somebody is refusing to break character.
game.headline: HALLOWEEN DRESS REHEARSAL GOES WILD AS ___ REFUSES TO TAKE OFF COSTUME

game.intro: Happy Halloween! The Fire Tiger is trick-or-treating and Saturn hands out one spooky number. Count every leg.
game.question: How many legs in total do two spiders, one black cat and one owl have?
game.source: Animal anatomy: each spider has 8 legs (16), a cat has 4, an owl has 2; 16 + 4 + 2 = 22.
